story.vex: Call it judgment. Call it whatever helps you skip the rule. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED before it began: real judgment is told apart from corner-cutting. Astro: "A reason you can explain later is judgment. A shortcut you can't is just a shortcut."
